messages.author: c64abac46f6443ee
messages.subject: Confidence interval of Overlap Estimate
parts:
Hi everyone,

I am sorry if this is not the right forum to ask this, but I have a doubt regarding the confidence interval calculated for the overlap estimate, using the package "overlap". But maybe someone here has some insights into this.

I am comparing the activity between two species and I calculated the overlap coefficient Dhat1 and the bootstrap mean of this coefficient so I can calculate the CI. I followed the tutorial from Mike Meredith and Martin Ridout  (https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/overlap/vignettes/overlap.pdf). However, for this particular species comparison the bootstrap mean is outside the CI (OverlapEst=0.89, CI= 0.91-0.98). I find this odd, but I have double checked the code and everything seems right. Any idea why this could happen?

>MartenGenet_overlapwinterGrandola <-
>   overlapEst(st_martenwinterGrandola, st_genetwinterGrandola, type="Dhat1")

>## bootstrap to obtain CI
>boot_MartenGenet_GrandolaWinter <-
>    bootstrap(st_martenwinterGrandola, st_genetwinterGrandola, 10000, type="Dhat1")
>### mean delta1 from bootstrap
>MartenGenet_GrandolaBSmean <- round(mean(boot_MartenGenet_GrandolaWinter), 2)
>### CI, basic0
>CI_MartenGenet_GrandolaWinter <-
 >   bootCIlogit(MartenGenet_overlapwinterGrandola, boot_MartenGenet_GrandolaWinter)


Once again, I apologize if this isn't the right place to ask this, but couldn't find a similar forum for the package "overlap". And thank you in advance for any comments.

Cheers,
Ana

Hi Ana,
this sounds odd, but since it is an overlap issue I unfortunately can't help with it. I'd recommend opening an issue on GitHub to ask the developers directly:
https://github.com/mikemeredith/overlap/issues

If you do, please try to provide a reproducible example to the developers. It helps the a lot.

Best regards,
Jürgen
